records.jp: やっぱ、水際は涼しいねー
records.en_original: Walking along the edge of the pool feels so nice and cool!
records.en: Walking along the edge of the pool feels so nice and cool!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、足元滑りやすいから<CR>気を付けるんだよ？
records.en_original: Be careful not to slip, Ao!
records.en: Be careful not to slip, Ao!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんこそ、気をつけてね？
records.en_original: Maybe you should be careful, Hiori!
records.en: Maybe you should be careful, Hiori!

records.jp: あはは、私は大丈夫！　スケート得意だもん！
records.en_original: Ahaha, I'll be fine! I know how to skate!
records.en: Ahaha, I'll be fine! I know how to skate!

records.jp: その滑るとは、ちょっと違う気がするけど……<CR>陽桜莉さんのスケート、見てみたいかも
records.en_original: That's not really the same thing... But I would like to see you skate sometime, Hiori.
records.en: That's not really the same thing... But I would like to see you skate sometime, Hiori.

records.jp: ここに、作れないかな。スケートリンク
records.en_original: I wonder if we could build a skating rink here.
records.en: I wonder if we could build a skating rink here.

records.jp: いやー、さすがにそれは無理じゃ……うわっ！？
records.en_original: Hmm, I feel like that might not be—whoa!
records.en: Hmm, I feel like that might not be—whoa!

records.jp: なんだか、お母さんみたい
records.en_original: You sound like a mom.
records.en: You sound like a mom.

records.jp: えっ、お母さん？<CR>それは、はじめて言われたかも
records.en_original: Huh, a mom? No one's ever said that to me before.
records.en: Huh, a mom? No one's ever said that to me before.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんって、結構周りのことよく見てると<CR>いうか……
records.en_original: I don't know exactly what it is. Maybe 'cause you always keep an eye on what's going on around you?
records.en: I don't know exactly what it is. Maybe 'cause you always keep an eye on what's going on around you?

records.jp: 意外と気遣いの人だなーと思って。<CR>ちょっとお節介な所もあるしねー
records.en_original: But I've always thought you were a caring person. You can even be a bit naggy sometimes.
records.en: But I've always thought you were a caring person. You can even be a bit naggy sometimes.

records.jp: えへへ……そうかなぁ？
records.en_original: Ehehe... You think so?
records.en: Ehehe... You think so?

records.jp: ……あれ？<CR>今のって……褒められてる？
records.en_original: ...Wait, was that a compliment?
records.en: ...Wait, was that a compliment?

records.jp: 褒めてる、褒めてる！　……って、うわっ！？
records.en_original: Yeah, totally! Wh-whoa!
records.en: Yeah, totally! Wh-whoa!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん！？
records.en_original: Ao?!
records.en: Ao?!

records.jp: （……びっくりしたあ）
（注意されたとたん、マジで滑るとか。<CR>　あ、でも。これ気持ちいいなあー……）
records.en_original: (I can't believe I slipped right after she told me to be careful. But, this feels pretty good...)
records.en: (I can't believe I slipped right after she told me to be careful. But, this feels pretty good...)

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、今行くよっ！
records.en_original: Ao! I'm coming!
records.en: Ao! I'm coming!

records.jp: えっ……？
records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: しっかり！<CR>愛央ちゃん、しっかりして！
records.en_original: Ao! Stay with me! Ao!
records.en: Ao! Stay with me! Ao!

records.jp: うう、どうしよう……
records.en_original: Oh no... What should I do...?
records.en: Oh no... What should I do...?

records.jp: （……私、めちゃくちゃ元気なんだけど）
records.en_original: (I feel totally fine, but...)
records.en: (I feel totally fine, but...)

records.jp: （陽桜莉さんが真剣すぎて、<CR>目を開けるタイミング逃しちゃったな……）
records.en_original: (Hiori's so worked up, I feel like I can't open my eyes now...)
records.en: (Hiori's so worked up, I feel like I can't open my eyes now...)

records.jp: すぐに助けを呼びに……！　あっ、でも！<CR>愛央ちゃんをここ置いてけないよぉ……！
records.en_original: I have to get help! But I can't leave Ao here like this...
records.en: I have to get help! But I can't leave Ao here like this...

records.jp: （陽桜莉さん、すごく心配してくれてる。<CR>こんな状況だけど、なんか嬉しいかも）
records.en_original: (Hiori's really worried about me. I wish the circumstances were different, but I'm glad.)
records.en: (Hiori's really worried about me. I wish the circumstances were different, but I'm glad.)

records.jp: （騙すみたいで心苦しいけど、もう少しだけ<CR>このままでいても……）
records.en_original: (I know it's kind of bad, but I just wanna stay like this a little bit longer...)
records.en: (I know it's kind of bad, but I just wanna stay like this a little bit longer...)

records.jp: こうなったら、あれしかないよねっ！
records.en_original: Oh, I know what to do!
records.en: Oh, I know what to do!

records.jp: 人工呼吸だっ！
records.en_original: CPR!
records.en: CPR!

records.jp: （え！？　人工呼吸！？）
records.en_original: (Huh?! CPR?!)
records.en: (Huh?! CPR?!)

records.jp: （どうしよう……<CR>とりあえず、このまま様子をみて……）
records.en_original: (What should I do...? I guess I'll just see how this plays out...)
records.en: (What should I do...? I guess I'll just see how this plays out...)

records.jp: えっと、口から息を吹き込めばいいんだよね……
records.en_original: Okay, I need to blow air into her lungs through her mouth...
records.en: Okay, I need to blow air into her lungs through her mouth...

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん。今、助けてあげるからね！
records.en_original: I'll save you, Ao!
records.en: I'll save you, Ao!

records.jp: （……あ、なんだか甘い匂いがする。<CR>これ、陽桜莉さんの匂い？）
records.en_original: (...Oh, I smell something sweet. Is that Hiori?)
records.en: (...Oh, I smell something sweet. Is that Hiori?)

records.jp: （うわ！　なんか、すごいドキドキしてきた！）
records.en_original: (Wow! My heart is racing all of a sudden!)
records.en: (Wow! My heart is racing all of a sudden!)

records.en_original: Hmmm...
records.en: Hmmm...

records.jp: （無理！　もう、限界っ！）
records.en_original: (I can't do this anymore!)
records.en: (I can't do this anymore!)

records.jp: 大丈夫、大丈夫だから！！
records.en_original: I'm fine! I'm fine!
records.en: I'm fine! I'm fine!

records.jp: 愛央……ちゃん？
ごめんなさい！　本当は、溺れてないの！<CR>溺れたふりをしてただけで……！
records.en_original: I'm so sorry! I wasn't really drowning! I was just pretending...
records.en: I'm so sorry! I wasn't really drowning! I was just pretending...

records.jp: え……ええええ～～っ！！
records.en_original: Wha... Whaaaaaat?!
records.en: Wha... Whaaaaaat?!

records.jp: ま、待って待って！　起きてる！
records.en_original: W-wait! Wait! I'm okay!
records.en: W-wait! Wait! I'm okay!

records.jp: ふぇっ！？<CR>あれ？　愛央ちゃん……？
records.en_original: Huh?! Ao...?
records.en: Huh?! Ao...?

records.jp: ……人工呼吸は？
records.en_original: ...Should I do CPR?
records.en: ...Should I do CPR?

records.jp: しなくて大丈夫！<CR>溺れてたふり、してただけだから！
records.en_original: Nope, no need! I was just pretending!
records.en: Nope, no need! I was just pretending!

records.jp: 溺れてたふり？　……えっ？<CR>えええ～～っ！！
records.en_original: Pretending? Wha...? Whaaaaaat?!
records.en: Pretending? Wha...? Whaaaaaat?!

records.jp: も～っ！　愛央ちゃんの、ばかっ！<CR>本当に心配したんだからねっ！
records.en_original: Ao, you idiot! I was really worried!
records.en: Ao, you idiot! I was really worried!

records.jp: ごめん、ごめん！
records.en_original: I know, I'm sorry!
records.en: I know, I'm sorry!

records.jp: どうして、溺れたふりなんてしたの？
records.en_original: Why would you pretend to be drowning?
records.en: Why would you pretend to be drowning?

records.jp: いや～、慌てる陽桜莉さんが面白くって
records.en_original: You're...kinda funny when you panic, Hiori.
records.en: You're...kinda funny when you panic, Hiori.

records.jp: 面白くって……！<CR>私は、面白くないよぉ！
records.en_original: I'm funny?! There's nothing funny about that!
records.en: I'm funny?! There's nothing funny about that!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんに、何かあったらどうしようって<CR>すっごく怖かったんだから……
records.en_original: I was so scared something had happened to you. I didn't know what to do...
records.en: I was so scared something had happened to you. I didn't know what to do...

records.jp: ……もう、こういうのはしちゃダメ
records.en_original: Don't ever do that again!
records.en: Don't ever do that again!

records.jp: うん……ごめんね
records.en_original: I won't... I'm sorry.
records.en: I won't... I'm sorry.

records.jp: もう、いいよ
records.en_original: Ugh, it's fine.
records.en: Ugh, it's fine.

records.jp: それより、ここまで濡れちゃったから<CR>もういっそのこと、プールで泳がない？
records.en_original: Since we're both soaking wet already, should we go for a swim?
records.en: Since we're both soaking wet already, should we go for a swim?

records.jp: あ、それいい！
records.en_original: Oh, good idea!
records.en: Oh, good idea!

records.jp: 向こう際まで、クロールで勝負っ！<CR>負けたら、かき氷おごりで！
records.en_original: The one who can swim to the other side fastest wins! Loser has to buy the winner shaved ice!
records.en: The one who can swim to the other side fastest wins! Loser has to buy the winner shaved ice!

records.jp: その勝負、のったあ！
records.en_original: You're on!
records.en: You're on!

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんが、可愛くてつい……
records.en_original: You were so cute, I just...
records.en: You were so cute, I just...

records.jp: 可愛くてって……そんな要素あったかなあ？
records.en_original: I don't see what could possibly have been cute about me just now.
records.en: I don't see what could possibly have been cute about me just now.

records.jp: あったよ！　私を心配して<CR>アワアワしてるところとか！
records.en_original: No, really! You were so worried about me you got all panicky and flustered!
records.en: No, really! You were so worried about me you got all panicky and flustered!

records.jp: むぅ～……<CR>こっちはそれどころじゃなかったのにい！
records.en_original: Ugh... Not really what I was going for!
records.en: Ugh... Not really what I was going for!

records.jp: あはは、ごめんごめん！<CR>本気で心配してくれたのも、なんか嬉しくてさ
records.en_original: Ahaha, sorry! I was just glad that you were really worried about me.
records.en: Ahaha, sorry! I was just glad that you were really worried about me.

records.jp: もう少しこのままって、思っちゃったんだよね
records.en_original: I wanted to hold on to that feeling a little bit longer.
records.en: I wanted to hold on to that feeling a little bit longer.

records.jp: ……私、いつだって愛央ちゃんのこと<CR>心配してるよ？
records.en_original: I'm always worried about you, Ao.
records.en: I'm always worried about you, Ao.

records.jp: えっ……？
records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: 無理してないかなーとか、怪我してないかなーとか、<CR>お腹空いてないかなーとか……いろいろ
records.en_original: I worry about a lot of things. Like whether you're pushing yourself too hard, or whether you're hurt, whether you're hungry...
records.en: I worry about a lot of things. Like whether you're pushing yourself too hard, or whether you're hurt, whether you're hungry...

records.jp: だから、何かあったらいつでも言ってね。<CR>愛央ちゃんの力になれたら、嬉しいから
records.en_original: So let me know if you need anything, okay? I'll always be there for you.
records.en: So let me know if you need anything, okay? I'll always be there for you.

records.jp: ……うん。<CR>陽桜莉さん、ありがとう
records.en_original: Yeah... Thanks, Hiori.
records.en: Yeah... Thanks, Hiori.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
